geometryDecision.reason: No safe native parcel ID plus full polygon was returned by an anonymous public request. The Hanchuan and bureau hosts reset or failed DNS in the available client; Tianditu public hosts returned HTTP 418 and no parcel schema or geometry. No TLS bypass, credentials, private token, or unsafe owner/address/title fields were used.
